auth: Header x-ingest-key = the Muse key from your private settings. Never write it anywhere.

endpoints.POST /: Send items. Body {"items":[...]} (max 100). Response: received, inserted, duplicates, metrics_updated, content_updated, rejected[{index,error}], remaining_today.
endpoints.GET /hunt-sources: Enabled sources for Muse: id, kind, value, label, show, tier, min_score, match_regex, cadence_min, note.
endpoints.GET /shows: Shows to hunt: id, name, aliases, hashtags, mode. Send `show` as the exact name; spin-offs go under the parent show.
endpoints.GET /contract: Currently accepted enum values and limits.

limits.note: Daily limit counts only NEW links (UTC day). Metric/content updates of known links are free.

shows_note: No fixed list: read GET /shows each run. The gateway maps aliases/spin-off names to the main name.

show.rule: name of a show from GET /shows when clear, else omit

event_at.rule: when the event itself happened, if stated

body.rule: original text, longer is cut. source_type news/other: full article up to 12000

media_urls.rule: images in original order. News: lead image first, then in-article images

sensitive_hint.rule: true for death, minors, abuse, explicit health details
